hero.headline: Optimise Your Production Schedule Network
hero.subheadline: GridSpace connects manufacturers, warehouse providers, and transport companies — then uses quantum-powered optimisation to coordinate production schedules across the entire chain, cutting costs, lead times, and idle capacity.

valueProp.headline: Coordinate production schedules across your entire supply chain.
valueProp.body: GridSpace is a production schedule coordination platform. It connects manufacturers, warehouse providers, and transport companies into a shared network — then uses a quantum-classical solver to find the optimal production schedule across all participants, minimising cost, lead time, and idle capacity simultaneously.

points.title: Shared production visibility
points.description: Every participant registers their real capacity windows, production slots, and constraints. GridSpace builds a live picture of what the whole network can actually deliver — and when.

points.title: Coordinated schedule optimisation
points.description: The solver allocates production runs, warehouse slots, and transport lanes together — not in isolation. The result is a coordinated schedule that eliminates bottlenecks and idle time across the chain.

points.title: Re-coordinate on demand
points.description: When a production line goes down, a shipment is delayed, or demand shifts — re-run the optimiser in seconds. The revised schedule accounts for every constraint across every participant.

howItWorks.headline: From network to coordinated schedule in three steps

steps.title: Register your company
steps.description: Add your production facilities, warehouses, or transport routes with real capacity windows, slot availability, cost, and location data. You become a live node in the GridSpace coordination network.

steps.title: Define your production requirements
steps.description: Specify product type, quantity, delivery window, quality standards, and budget constraints. Set hard limits or let the solver balance trade-offs across the network automatically.

steps.title: Get your coordinated production schedule
steps.description: The hybrid quantum-classical solver evaluates every possible allocation across all participants and returns a fully coordinated production schedule — with cost, lead-time, and capacity breakdown.

participants.headline: Every node in the production chain, coordinated
participants.intro: GridSpace works because every participant contributes real capacity and schedule data. The more companies that join, the better the coordination gets for everyone.

items.label: Manufacturers
items.tagline: Fill production slots. Eliminate idle capacity.
items.description: Register your production facilities with capacity windows, run rates, product types, and unit cost. GridSpace coordinates your schedule with upstream suppliers and downstream logistics so every slot is filled efficiently — and you're never waiting on a partner.

items.label: Warehouse Providers
items.tagline: Synchronise inbound flows. Reduce dwell time.
items.description: List your available CBM, storage types, handling rates, and daily cost. GridSpace coordinates production run timing with your inbound capacity so goods arrive when you have space — not before, not after.

items.label: Transport Companies
items.tagline: Load lanes on schedule. Cut empty miles.
items.description: Define your origin-destination routes with transit times, mode, and freight cost. The scheduler times production completions and warehouse releases to match your departure windows — giving you full loads and fewer empty runs.

items.title: Live capacity network
items.description: Every manufacturer, warehouse, and carrier registers real production slots, capacity windows, and availability — not estimates. The scheduler works from ground truth.

items.title: Quantum schedule optimisation
items.description: Hybrid quantum-classical solver coordinates production runs, storage slots, and transport lanes simultaneously — finding the schedule that minimises cost and lead time across the whole chain.

items.title: Cost & utilisation analytics
items.description: Drill into production cost, storage cost, and transport cost by participant, lane, or time period. See exactly where idle capacity and schedule gaps are costing you.

items.title: Constraint engine
items.description: Encode minimum run quantities, capacity windows, quality certifications, regulatory requirements, and custom business rules as hard or soft constraints on every schedule.

items.title: Re-coordinate on demand
items.description: Production line down? Shipment delayed? Demand spike? Re-run the scheduler in seconds to get a revised, fully coordinated schedule across all participants.

items.title: API-first integration
items.description: Connect your ERP, MES, WMS, or TMS via REST API. GridSpace acts as the coordination and optimisation layer between your existing production systems.

cta.headline: Your coordinated production schedule is waiting
cta.subheadline: Join manufacturers, warehouse providers, and logistics companies already using GridSpace to coordinate production schedules, cut costs, and hit delivery targets.
